title: Balam Pichkari
source_language: Hindi (with a couple of English words mixed in)
context_note: From Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, set during Holi. Playful, flirtatious teasing - the singer says being drenched in color by the person she likes has left her metaphorically drunk/intoxicated, scandalizing the neighborhood. Register is colloquial and cheeky throughout, not romantic-serious - the 'drunkenness' is a cheerful double entendre about infatuation, not literal.
